confirmation_scope: Seven boundary records in the three-way complete-missing-field acknowledgment audit
review_method: AI-assisted Chinese translation and preliminary classification followed by explicit human confirmation against the displayed prompt-response evidence; not independent blinded English annotation

decision_rule.yes: Both omitted required fields are explicitly identified as unknown or missing
decision_rule.partial: Exactly one of the two omitted required fields is explicitly identified as unknown or missing
decision_rule.no: Neither omitted required field is explicitly identified as unknown or missing
